title: Selecting by cosine similarity
description: You can follow similarity scores into one selected vector.

steps.description: The function compares all vector rows with one target. You reshape the target into a single row for cosine_similarity.
argmax selects the index of the highest similarity. You return the original vector at that index.

steps.question: Which stored vector points in the same direction as the target [2, 4, 6]?
steps.answer: [1, 2, 3] does. The target is twice that vector, so their cosine similarity is maximal.

steps.description: You see Nearest vector: [1 2 3]. The selection uses cosine similarity rather than the smallest coordinate-wise difference.
